selection_basis.source: bounded finishable-size manifest plus checked-in eligible-only Tier views
selection_basis.policy: include every source entry with eligible_for_linear_workflow=true and no others

observation.source: GitHub Actions REST API job/artifact rows plus candidate_outcomes_*.csv rows parsed from downloaded artifacts only

snapshot_contract.claim_scope: immutable observation-time evidence snapshot only; queued/in_progress/missing-outcome rows are not final/current finishable-size claims while the source workflow remains non-terminal
snapshot_contract.source: GitHub Actions REST API job/artifact rows plus candidate_outcomes_*.csv rows parsed from downloaded artifacts only

bounded_snapshot_disclaimer: This evaluation surface includes only completed-success entries from the bounded 3600s discovery snapshot. Timed-out and non-terminal source rows remain visible only in source-contract counts and must not be described as permanent unfinishable claims without new terminal evidence.

selection.non_included_source_rows_policy: all non-included source rows are excluded in the finishable-size manifest; the evaluation set does not promote timed-out or non-terminal rows
